author: Ubisoft
description:
Elite Bundle 8, available April 14! 
Hennessy: From Texas roots to world records. Since 1991, Hennessey engineers ultimate performance, the Venom F5 delivers 1,800+ hp, built for 300+ mph.

Superleggera: From Milan, 1926, Touring Superleggera creates cars where art meets engineering 🇮🇹. The Arese flows with precision and handcrafted finesse.

About The Crew Motorfest:
Welcome to Motorfest! Discover the evergreen festival featuring the best experiences car culture has to offer. Complete your ultimate action driving bucket list through a series of tailor-made races, themed events, and other unique challenges. Explore the vibrant island of O’ahu in Hawaii alone or with your crew. Whatever the way you enjoy cars and driving, there is something in there for you!

#Ubisoft #TheCrew #TheCrewMotorfest

description:
In this final episode of the behind Anvil engine video series, discover how Anvil’s ray traced global illumination brings dynamic, realistic lighting to Assassin’s Creed Shadows allowing light to adapt seamlessly to a living ever-changing open world. Find out more about how the Anvil engine helped define the world of Assassin’s Creed Shadows with our other episodes!

About Assassin's Creed:
Discover the award-winning Assassin's Creed franchise with more than 230M games sold. Travel through time in this action-adventure video game series and explore fascinating historical settings including the American Revolution, Feudal Japan, Ancient Greece and Renaissance Italy.
You'll find here the latest trailers and gameplay videos, updates on upcoming and ongoing games, developer insights and behind-the-scenes content, and much more!
